coverage_summary: Reviewed all three trajectories. Opaque embedding, encoder, fusion, objective, and decoder boundaries are appropriately preserved. Revision is required for the unsupported HPO lookup decomposition, incomplete positional-addition evidence, ambiguous sampling parameter, and unsupported heatmap port bindings.

findings.detail: The sample invocation records three alternative strategies as one method value, although the paper does not identify which strategy is used for a particular inference run.

evidence.quote: Sampling strategies such as beam search, top-k, or nucleus sampling (P-sampling) are applied to increase diversity and fluency of the generated text.

findings.required_change: Represent the method as unspecified with these documented alternatives, or create conditional branches for the alternatives; do not treat the disjunction as one selected method.

findings.detail: The heatmap step binds decoder_state and positionally encoded feature nodes to token-specific visualization ports. The paper establishes input-token/output-token attention maps and mentions genomic patterns and clinical phrases, but does not establish decoder_state as an input to visualization or the exact feature-to-token alignment.

evidence.quote: where 𝐴𝑖𝑗 ∈ [0,1] quantifies the influence of input token jjj on output token iii.
Visualizing these attention maps allows clinicians to understand which genomic patterns and clinical phrases drive specific diagnostic outputs.

findings.required_change: Remove unsupported decoder_state binding and either bind documented token-level operands with an explicit alignment or retain the visualization inputs as unresolved within the opaque boundary.
